observations: Word division uses unsigned DX:AX and returns a word quotient in AX and remainder in DX.
A zero divisor or quotient beyond word range causes divide error, including real-address mode.
Arithmetic flags after DIV are unspecified; fault comparisons use the captured pre-instruction carry.
